primary.title: MakeMyTrip IPO soon! Online travel giant files confidential DRHP with SEBI, 15 years after Nasdaq listing
primary.summary: MakeMyTrip has initiated the process for its India IPO by filing a Draft Red Herring Prospectus with SEBI. The offering involves an equity share sale by MakeMyTrip Limited and its subsidiary, ibibo Group, but details like the issue size remain undisclosed.
